scope: R0 current local runtime and declared future boundaries; statuses describe only implemented controls.

records.current_control: source hashes, provenance and validation artifacts
records.required_mitigation: independent source review and acquisition provenance workflow
records.residual_risk: an authentic-looking official source can still be misleading

records.current_control: manifest hashes, semantic validation, exact-commit archive verification
records.required_mitigation: protected release signing and independent artifact attestation
records.residual_risk: local checkout integrity is outside runtime control

records.current_control: corpus-specific validators and fail-closed verified loading
records.required_mitigation: reviewed ingestion provenance and anomaly monitoring
records.verification_test: artifact validation and retrieval evaluation gates
records.residual_risk: semantic poisoning that satisfies current rules can remain

records.asset: external LLM planning and wording boundaries
records.actor: query author or retrieved document author
records.entry_point: bounded planning request or verified-claim wording request
records.trust_boundary: local control plane to optional external provider
records.impact: prompt injection, scope drift or unsupported publication
records.current_control: explicit opt-in; no model tools; planner output is schema-bounded, untrusted and cannot author evidence policy; wording receives verified claims and is publication-validated with deterministic fallback
records.required_mitigation: provider data-governance review, credential rotation and continued adversarial boundary tests
records.verification_test: hybrid-research, runtime wording and trust-boundary contracts plus live planner integration
records.residual_risk: provider processing and novel schema-valid adversarial output remain external risks

records.current_control: hashed Python lock, npm lock, full-SHA Actions, audits and reports
records.required_mitigation: dependency update review and trusted publishing/signing policy
records.verification_test: CI hash install, audits and pinned-action review
records.residual_risk: hosted runner and registry trust remain external

records.required_mitigation: release approval and external secret scanning
records.verification_test: clean-handoff contract and CI release gate
records.residual_risk: committed sensitive content is not detected by forbidden-path checks

records.trust_boundary: internal evidence model to public surface
records.current_control: public projection and smoke leakage assertions
records.required_mitigation: API contract review for every public field
records.verification_test: runtime and browser smoke public-leakage checks
records.residual_risk: new projections can bypass existing assertions

records.entry_point: HTTP headers, body, origin and bind address
records.impact: CORS abuse, malformed request handling, resource exhaustion or exposure
records.current_control: loopback default, CORS allowlist, request-size bound and malformed-request tests
records.required_mitigation: production server, rate limits, timeouts and deployment network policy
records.residual_risk: development HTTP server is not a production deployment control

records.entry_point: future OAuth callback and session handling
records.impact: account takeover or tenant isolation failure
records.required_mitigation: OIDC validation, secure session lifecycle and tenant authorization design

records.asset: future database, tenant data and quotas
records.trust_boundary: application to database and tenant quota
records.impact: data exposure, cross-tenant access or resource exhaustion
records.current_control: none; database, tenancy and quotas are absent
records.required_mitigation: tenant-scoped authorization, database controls and quota enforcement
records.verification_test: future authorization, isolation and quota tests
